tools.name: get_design_context
tools.description: Returns design context for a layer or selection, by default as React and Tailwind code to adapt to the project.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Returns a sparse XML outline of a selection; omit nodeId to list top-level pages.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Takes a screenshot of a selection.

tools.name: download_assets
tools.description: Downloads exports and original source images for up to 20 nodes as temporary URLs (PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF).

tools.name: get_variable_defs
tools.description: Returns the variables and styles used in a selection.

tools.name: get_motion_context
tools.description: Returns keyframe animation data and code snippets for a node.

tools.name: get_figjam
tools.description: Converts FigJam diagrams to XML with screenshots.

tools.name: use_figma
tools.description: Creates, edits, deletes or inspects objects in Design files, FigJam boards and Slides decks.

tools.name: generate_figma_design
tools.description: Sends live UI from a web app as design layers to a new or existing Figma file, or the clipboard.

tools.name: create_new_file
tools.description: Creates a blank Design, FigJam or Slides file in drafts.

tools.name: upload_assets
tools.description: Uploads PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP images (max 10MB each) into a Figma file.

tools.name: generate_diagram
tools.description: Generates a FigJam diagram from Mermaid or natural language.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Creates a raster image from a text prompt and returns a temporary URL (uses Figma AI credits).

tools.name: get_libraries
tools.description: Lists subscribed and available design libraries.

tools.name: search_design_system
tools.description: Searches connected libraries for components, variables and styles.

queries.description: Each entry is one search intent.

tools.name: get_code_connect_map
tools.description: Retrieves mappings from Figma node IDs to code components.

tools.name: add_code_connect_map
tools.description: Maps a Figma node ID to a code component.

tools.name: get_code_connect_suggestions
tools.description: Suggests Code Connect mappings between Figma components and code.

tools.name: get_context_for_code_connect
tools.description: Returns component metadata for Code Connect templates.

tools.name: send_code_connect_mappings
tools.description: Confirms suggested Code Connect mappings.

tools.name: list_generative_plugins
tools.description: Lists generative plugins in your account library.

tools.name: get_generative_plugin
tools.description: Reads a generative plugin's source manifest.

tools.name: create_generative_plugin
tools.description: Creates a generative plugin scaffold.

tools.name: update_generative_plugin
tools.description: Replaces a generative plugin's code.ts or ui.html and deploys a new version.

tools.name: list_shaders
tools.description: Lists shader effects and fills in your library.

tools.name: get_shader
tools.description: Reads a shader's source manifest.

tools.name: create_shader
tools.description: Creates a shader scaffold.

tools.name: update_shader
tools.description: Replaces a shader's main.ts and deploys a new version.

tools.name: list_file_shaders
tools.description: Lists shaders used in a Figma file (requires file view access).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Returns the authenticated user's email, plans and seat types.

tools.name: weave_list_tools
tools.description: Lists Weave tools the user can run (private tools excluded).

tools.name: weave_get_tool_inputs
tools.description: Returns a Weave tool's input contract.

tools.name: weave_upload_asset
tools.description: Creates a hosted URL for an attached file to use as a Weave tool input.

tools.name: weave_run_tool
tools.description: Starts one or more Weave tool runs; may require cost confirmation.

tools.name: weave_get_tool_run_output
tools.description: Returns the status and outputs of Weave tool runs.

tools.name: weave_cancel_tool_run
tools.description: Cancels Weave tool runs; cannot be undone.

runIds.description: Optional run IDs; omit to cancel all.
